title.narrative: 5% GLOBAL FUND DOTAZIONE FINANZIARIA 2023-2025 PER LA LOTTA A AIDS, TUBERCOLOSI E MALARIA
5% GLOBAL FUND FINANCIAL ENDOWMENT 2023-2025 FOR THE FIGHT AGAINST AIDS, TUBERCULOSIS AND MALARIA

description.narrative: Contributo core al bilancio generale del Fondo Globale per la lotto ad AIDS, Tubercolosi e Malaria trattenuto da AICS per finanziare Iniziative sinergiche proposte da OSC, Enti pubblici di ricerca e Università nel quadro del Technical Support Spending al Fondo Globale per la lotta all’AIDS, alla Tubercolosi e alla Malaria.

Core contribution to the general budget of the Global Fund to fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria retained by AICS to finance synergistic initiatives proposed by CSOs, public research bodies and universities in the framework of the Technical Support Spending to the Global Fund to fight against AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria.
